findings.claim: The only place the ruled P6 value is written out says 'P6 Writer the `put` node', but the design makes put.ts the writer for two nodes, `put-open` and `put` (gauntlet-intake-design.md:137, :197-203). Applying D-44(b) from that text leaves P6 missing the node that writes the opening draft.
findings.failure_scenario: An editor applies D-44 using G-64 option (b) and sets the P6 Writer cell to node `put` only. A later phase builds against P6 as the closed inventory. Its test or fence fixture then treats `put` as the only writer of gauntlet/tasks/<slug>.md. A draft Clerk produces on its opening turn is written by `put-open`, so that fixture flags it or misses it, even though the design lists `put-open` as a writer.
